body: **Finding from the DM-61 end-to-end run (decision needed, low).** An agent can resume a run that was paused for `signed_out`. After Retry, the orchestrator chat called `resume_run` over MCP, and it succeeded once an approval card was allowed (`run.leases_extended` and `run.resumed` by the MCP session). The ticket and runbook say the person resumes from the run bar. Options: gate resume of a `signed_out` pause to the desktop session the same way the pause is gated, or document that an approved agent may resume. Also seen: after resume, the attempt had only the lease time it had left at the pause (about 29 s), and the worker's submit missed it by 4 s, which led to a lease_expired, then a reconcile/resubmit. That's a rough edge with short leases.
